name: Minecraft: Waterdog PE
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: WaterdogPE, a proxy for Minecraft: Bedrock Edition that links several Bedrock servers into one network players move between. Installs any release, checked against GitHub's checksums.
startup: mkdir -p plugins/bStats; b=plugins/bStats/config.txt; touch $b; if ! grep -q "^server-uuid=" $b; then read -r u < /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid; echo "server-uuid=$u" >> $b; fi; if grep -q "^enabled=" $b; then sed -i "s/^enabled=.*/enabled={{BSTATS}}/" $b; else echo "enabled={{BSTATS}}" >> $b; fi; touch config.yml; for kv in enable_statistics={{BSTATS}} enable_error_reporting={{ERROR_REPORTS}}; do k=${kv%%=*}; v=${kv#*=}; if grep -q "^$k:" config.yml; then sed -i "s/^$k:.*/$k: $v/" config.yml; else echo "$k: $v" >> config.yml; fi; done; read -r need 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This server needs Java %s or newer, but Java %s is chosen. Choose Java %s or newer in Startup, then start the server again.\n", need, have, need; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -Dterminal.ansi=true -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: Waterdog PE. Downloads a WaterdogPE release from GitHub and
# checks it against the checksum GitHub publishes. config.yml and plugins
# are never touched, and the jar is only replaced once the new one has
# downloaded and checked out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
# The Java version the jar was built for, from its main class's file format.
jar_java() {
    local main major
    main=$(unzip -p "$1" META-INF/MANIFEST.MF | tr -d '\r' | sed -n 's/^Main-Class: *//p' | head -n 1)
    [ -n "$main" ] || { echo 8; return; }
    major=$(unzip -p "$1" "${main//.//}.class" | od -An -j6 -N2 -tu1 | awk '{ print $1 * 256 + $2 }')
    if [ -n "$major" ] && [ "$major" -gt 52 ]; then echo $((major - 44)); else echo 8; fi
}

# gh_release <owner/repo> <tag, or latest> <file>: sets tag and sum (the
# SHA-256 GitHub publishes, or -), through the installer's gh-release
# (GitHub's API has a low anonymous limit). Returns 1 when there's no such
# release or file, 2 when GitHub can't be reached.
gh_release() {
    local repo=$1 want=$2 asset=$3 out assets
    if ! out=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$want" 2>&1); then
        case "$out" in *"has no release"* | *"no releases"*) return 1 ;; *) return 2 ;; esac
    fi
    tag=$out
    assets=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag") || return 2
    sum=$(awk -v a="$asset" '$1 == a { print $2; f = 1 } END { exit !f }' <<<"$assets") || return 1
}

# WaterdogPE's newest build is the release tagged latest; older ones are v2.0.3 and so on.
want="${WATERDOG_VERSION:-latest}"
case "$want" in latest | v*) ;; *) want="v$want" ;; esac
rc=0; gh_release WaterdogPE/WaterdogPE "$want" Waterdog.jar || rc=$?
case $rc in
1) fail "WaterdogPE has no release ${WATERDOG_VERSION}. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 2.0.3." ;;
2) fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again." ;;
esac
name="WaterdogPE $tag"
[ "$tag" = latest ] && name="WaterdogPE's newest build"

if [ "$sum" != - ] && [ -f "$jar" ] && [ "$(sha256sum "$jar" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
    echo "$name is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading $name"
    # gh-release replaces the jar only once the new one has arrived and checked out.
    gh-release download WaterdogPE/WaterdogPE "$tag" Waterdog.jar "$jar" || fail "The download from GitHub failed or didn't match GitHub's checksum. Reinstall to try again."
fi
java=$(jar_java "$jar")
echo "$java" > .raptor-java
echo "Installed $name. It needs Java $java or newer."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The WaterdogPE release, such as 2.0.3, or latest for the newest build. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: The name of the proxy's jar file.

variables.name: Usage statistics
variables.description: Send anonymous statistics about the proxy and its plugins to bStats.org, where plugin authors see them (true or false).

variables.name: Error reports
variables.description: Send WaterdogPE's developers anonymous reports of errors the proxy hits, through Bugsnag (true or false).
